pr_title: Make Ruler Tool depend on grid snap only

issue_context.title: Ruler tool units don't show when only grid snap is enabled
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
930d6d8

**Issue description:**
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/67519063-5a35f380-f6a6-11e9-8747-3116daf25e5a.png)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2223172/67519067-5bffb700-f6a6-11e9-84c6-3d0f9b8a0124.png)

Units should appear in both cases. And probably shouldn't if only Smart Snapping is enabled.

review_comments: Won't this prevent using <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> as a modifier to temporarily toggle snapping?
This is only for drawing the ruler units I guess. So I don't think it should hurt.
I might be wrong, but I wonder since my last changes, if Ctrl has an impact on the grid snapping. It might be working only for the smart snapping now.
Yeah, Ctrl doesn't affect grid snapping anymore, so I disabled it.
